question: Why is 4x8 the default size for community/real-estate signs, and is it optimal?
summary: Derived 4x8 independently from legibility (~1in letter per 30ft at 45mph -> ~10in letters -> ~4x8 panel) and from the construction framing module (16/24in OC, 8ft walls); predicted 32 sq ft code caps downstream of the sheet. Corpus confirms the framing origin, 32/64 sq ft code tiers and the 1in per 25-40ft roadside legibility range. Minor novel framing: 4x8 as a multi-layer coordination equilibrium; implication is to price by sheet consumed and size up by whole sheets according to road speed.
